integration_decision.name: NONVACUOUS_PRE_ORPHAN_APPEND_WITNESS
integration_decision.finding: Pre-cleanup run_once TimeoutError plus absence of outputs alone is non-specific: runner catches JsonlFlowAdapter parse errors, then append_observations([]) skips its writer lock and load_observations can raise the same TimeoutError. Thus a malformed/empty external fixture can make a negative orphan-lock oracle pass without exercising the append path. Existing archive reader/writer visibility and individual-file atomicity tests cover different primitives; neither proves full three-file run_once generation consistency.
integration_decision.contract: Use a fresh isolated tmp_path and immutable canonical PIT-visible rowB input.jsonl. Before inducing orphan, positively verify list(JsonlFlowAdapter(input_path).collect()) is exactly one rowB with observation_id, source_record_id=rowB, visible clocks; ensure archive/output paths absent. Spawn lock owner, ACK acquisition, os._exit(17), bounded join, confirm exitcode=17 and test-owned orphan. Invoke the SAME run_once(network=False,external_jsonl=(input_path,),local_dir=tmp_path,as_of_ms=T) before cleanup in a bounded child; require TimeoutError and no observations.jsonl/latest.json/audit_latest.json/anata_latest.json. Preserve orphan. After confirmed child death remove only test-owned lock, call identical run_once; assert collection_attempt OK/count1, source_errors=[], appended=1, archive/scoring=1/1, persisted and returned rowB scoring source_record_id, no lock. Repeat: appended=0, archive/scoring=1/1, same single rowB identity. Keep separate positive-ACK overlapping-writer lock-vs-mixed-generation and same-clock rollback tests; do not conflate archive atomicity with three-file generation atomicity.
integration_decision.proof_boundary: No test executed and no production defect established. A timeout alone does not identify which lock acquisition failed; immutable positive adapter witness plus same fixture and post-cleanup append=1 make the intended path non-vacuous.
